helpPage.title: Help Support
helpPage.centerDesc: Use this support center to jump to the right Humaeli feature, troubleshoot common issues, and understand when to contact urgent help outside the app.
helpPage.aiWellnessDesc: Ask mental-wellness questions, use voice input, get quick replies, and continue your recent AI chat from the dashboard.
helpPage.counselorDesc: Browse consultants by name, specialization, language, location, rating, and online status before starting care.
helpPage.appointmentsDesc: Review upcoming and past appointments, check request status, and book sessions with available consultants.
helpPage.walletDesc: Add money, review transactions, download wallet reports, and contact support for payment questions.
helpPage.checklist1: Confirm your internet connection and refresh the app before reporting a loading issue.
helpPage.checklist2: Keep the latest screenshot, exact time, and the screen name ready when contacting support.
helpPage.checklist3: For camera, microphone, notification, and location issues, check device app permissions first.
helpPage.checklist4: For payment issues, include date, amount, transaction status, and wallet balance shown in the app.
helpPage.aiChatNotReplyDesc: Check your internet connection, try sending a short message, and reopen the AI chat from the dashboard. If it still fails, share the exact error screenshot with support.
helpPage.counselorChatNotOpenDesc: Open Consultant Support, choose an available consultant, and wait for the request to be accepted. Existing chats appear in the consultant chat screen.
helpPage.callNotConnectingDesc: Make sure the consultant has accepted your chat/session, both users are online, and microphone/camera permissions are allowed.
helpPage.walletPaymentIssueDesc: Open Wallet to review the latest transaction and download a report. Share the date, amount, and transaction status when contacting support.
helpPage.languageWrongDesc: Use the language selector from the dashboard/settings. Some consultant or medical details may remain in the language entered by the provider.
helpPage.needMoreHelpDesc: Update account details from Profile/Settings, or email support with screenshots, app version, user email/phone, and the exact time the issue happened. For crisis support in India, call 9152987821 or local emergency services.

privacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPage.centerDesc: This privacy center explains how Humaeli uses your profile, chat, appointment, wallet, call, location, and security data inside this mobile app.
privacyPage.profileHealthDesc: Your name, anonymous display name, age, gender, contact details, photo/avatar, address, emergency contact, basic medical details, and insurance fields are used to maintain your patient profile.
privacyPage.aiConversationsDesc: Messages, quick replies, chat status, attachments, accepted chat sessions, and consultant details are used to provide conversations, continue history, and support rating prompts.
privacyPage.appointmentsDesc: Appointment date, time, reason/notes, status, assigned consultant, call metadata, and session history help users and consultants manage care.
privacyPage.walletDesc: Wallet balance, top-ups, transaction records, generated reports, and related support context are used for payment tracking.
privacyPage.locationDesc: Location can be captured at signup, login, or manual refresh to verify sessions, support account safety, and improve location-aware care features.
privacyPage.securityDesc: Login tokens, auth provider, password status, OTP verification, role, and account status are used to keep user and consultant areas separated and protected.
privacyPage.visibleDesc: Your dashboard shows your profile, AI chats, consultant interactions, appointments, wallet, call history, ratings prompts, and location/update controls.
privacyPage.sharedDesc: Consultants may see the information needed to manage accepted sessions, appointments, and support conversations. Anonymous identity is used where supported.
privacyPage.protectedDesc: User and consultant areas are separated by role, active sessions, OTP verification, and authenticated API requests.
privacyPage.checklistItem1: Use your anonymous name for consultant interactions when you do not want your real name displayed.
privacyPage.checklistItem2: Keep emergency contact and medical profile details accurate if you choose to fill them in.
privacyPage.checklistItem3: Review device permissions for location, camera, and microphone before calls.
privacyPage.checklistItem4: Update location manually from Settings/Profile if the login prompt was skipped.
privacyPage.checklistItem5: Do not share OTPs, passwords, or sensitive account details inside chat messages.
privacyPage.checklistItem6: Use My Profile and Settings to update or review the data stored in your account.
privacyPage.aiVoiceHint: Speak when you're ready — I'll reply once you pause.
privacyPage.resetChatMessage: This clears the current AI chat and starts again with the welcome mood options.

phrases.p1o9zyax: Earnings from a completed session move to your available balance once the session is marked complete. You can request a withdrawal from Earnings & Payouts at any time, as long as your payout account is verified. Standard payouts settle to your bank in 2-3 working days; instant payouts settle sooner and carry a fee shown before you confirm.
phrases.p1ylrl1: How is my earning per session calculated?
phrases.pg1egtz: Each session is split between your share and the platform commission. The exact percentages, and what that means in rupees, are shown on the Consultant share and Platform commission cards in Earnings. Your payout is the session amount minus that commission.
phrases.pmsn1wi: Why am I not receiving new chat requests?
phrases.p1ob6zhl: New requests only reach consultants who are online. Check that your status shows Online on the dashboard, that the app has notification permission, and that you have a working internet connection. Requests already accepted continue to appear under Messages regardless of your status.
phrases.p19hxzae: How do I accept a session request?
phrases.p1fu2ich: Open the Requests or Appointments tab, review the request, and tap Accept. Once accepted, the chat opens under Messages and the client can message you. Scheduling an appointment only becomes available after you accept.
phrases.p1i14c0d: How do I start a video or voice session?
phrases.p1jzu4ai: Open the accepted chat or the confirmed appointment and use the video or voice button. Both sides need camera and microphone permission granted and a stable connection. For a scheduled appointment, the Conduct Session button appears when the session is due.
phrases.p5o9ibr: How do I get my profile verified?
phrases.pthq954: Go to Profile and upload your qualification certificates and identity document, then complete your specialities, languages and experience. Verification is reviewed by our team; you will see a verified badge on your profile once it is approved.
phrases.pcs6ob0: What happens if I miss a scheduled appointment?
phrases.pbpennv: Missed sessions are visible to the client and affect your rating. If you cannot attend, message the client in advance through the chat so the appointment can be rescheduled. If something goes wrong on the day, email support with the appointment date and time.
phrases.p1kk9y4g: Clients can rate a consultant after a completed session. Your rating is the average of those scores. Consultants with no ratings yet are shown as New rather than with a score.
phrases.p33cxw1: If a client discloses intent to harm themselves or someone else, stay with them in the session, encourage them to contact emergency services, and escalate to our clinical support team straight away.
phrases.p1lipav4: A client is at immediate risk
phrases.p1xvvi55: Stay in the session, keep the client talking, and escalate without delay. Do not end the conversation while they are in danger.

phrases.pzvbnaj: When can I start a consultation?
phrases.p1do2tiq: A patient can be started from their slot time, or earlier when they are first in line after the previous patient was seen or moved to Next. Walk-ins and emergencies can be started at once. Nobody can be started while another consultation is running or you are on a break. If a patient has not arrived, tap Next in the consent form: they move to the Next tab and the following patient comes up — you can start them from the Next tab later. Video calls open 15 minutes before the slot and stay available until 90 minutes after it.
phrases.ptqgunu: What does the coloured badge on a queue card mean?
phrases.p1i2aeff: It shows how the patient is being seen: In-clinic Visit, Walk-in Visit or Video Consultation. The tabs above the queue show whether it is Pending, In Progress, Next (moved aside), Completed or Cancelled (cancelled or no-show, as marked by the system).
phrases.phv9ik2: How is Today's Appointment Queue ordered?
phrases.p1bmfdp1: Emergencies come first. Everyone else is in order of their slot time, and by token number when the time is the same. The first Pending card, and the Next Patient card, is always the next patient to call.
phrases.p7duxis: An appointment's time has passed — where did it go?
phrases.ph0jdw9: Nowhere. Today's pending appointments stay in the Pending tab even after their slot time, so no patient is lost. Start the consultation when you're ready.
phrases.p1pcz6sw: How do I set my available slots?
phrases.pnyk7yv: Open Calendar, choose your clinic, add time ranges for a weekday or a specific date (Morning / Afternoon / Evening presets are available), then tap Generate Slots to preview them. Mark a date unavailable to block it.
phrases.pnrgjit: How do I schedule a follow-up?
phrases.p1sldnnf: Tick "Follow-up required" and pick a date when you complete an appointment, or open Follow-ups and tap New Follow-up to add one for any patient.
phrases.po7whwn: Tap Take Break on the dashboard and choose a duration. Your queue pauses and the break ends automatically when the time runs out, or tap End Break to finish early.
phrases.pnbgjmh: How do walk-in patients book with me?
phrases.p1ayn51s: Share your Profile QR (Settings → Profile QR). Patients scan it to register as a walk-in for your clinic, and they appear in your queue with a token.
phrases.pxoe1wv: Check Settings → Notification Preferences (notifications on, the right categories on, quiet hours off), and that notifications are allowed for Humaeli in your phone's settings. You only receive notifications on the one device you're signed in on.
phrases.pt59u1v: Your account can be signed in on one device at a time. Signing in on another phone signs this one out automatically. Changing your password also signs you out.
